portada.titulo: Giant org charts, on your computer
portada.texto: Build your organization's org chart and a record for each person. No server, no accounts, and no need for internet: your data stays with you.

imagen.alt: Sample org chart: General Management with Operations, Finance and People; Operations open down to Maintenance, Production, Mechanical and Electrical, with heads, headcount and vacancies.

beneficios.titulo: When the spreadsheet falls short and the data must stay on your computer

items.titulo: The org chart comes from your data
items.texto: Assign a holder or move a unit, and the tree, the headcount and the vacancies update on their own.

items.titulo: Your people's records stay with you
items.texto: Contact details, contract, site, shift, notes and photo stay in a SQLite database on your computer, with no accounts and no server.

items.titulo: You share only what's needed, encrypted
items.texto: Export the whole database or a branch to an encrypted .boldo file, with a one-time code that is not saved anywhere.

items.titulo: It runs from a USB drive, with its backups
items.texto: The portable version doesn't install: your data stays next to the program, with an automatic backup every 24 hours.

nuevo.titulo: The latest you can already use

items.texto: AGPL-3.0 license. All the code is on GitHub for anyone to review.
Every release publishes SHA256SUMS.txt and the list of its components. The app rejects an update if its signature doesn't match.
The app has no analytics and no telemetry, and it sends your data nowhere.

items.titulo: It helps you meet personal-data rules
items.texto: The data stays on your computer and the files you share are encrypted: that helps you meet the rules that apply to you. Handling it lawfully is the responsibility of whoever uses the app.
